newsitem.title: UK: Rolls-Royce in 25 mln stg power station order.
newsitem.headline: Rolls-Royce in 25 mln stg power station order.

text.p: Rolls-Royce Plc on Monday said it had won a 25 million stg order to upgrade the 45 megawatt Nairobi South power station in Kenya.
The engineering group's Allen Diesels unit is responsible for all the mechanical and electrical engineering as well as the supply of eight 5.8 megawatt Niigata heavy fuel burning engines from Japan.
Allen Diesels, part of Rolls-Royce Industrial and Marine Power, supplied the 18V32CLX engines to the station which is expected to start producing power by this summer.
The order is from Iberafrica Power of which Spanish contractor Union Fenosa is the major shareholder. Union Fenosa will supply power to the Kenya Power and Light Corp for seven years.
